response.original_title: What happens during a power failure?
response.overview: During a power failure, a pit parking system is designed to keep vehicles safe. Most modern systems include an emergency manual operating system or a battery backup that allows the parking platform to be moved so vehicles can be retrieved safely. This helps reduce inconvenience and ensures the system remains secure until the power supply is restored. A pit stack parking system is built with multiple safety features, such as emergency lowering functions, safety locks, overload protection, and manual controls. These features prevent sudden platform movement and keep parked vehicles secure during a power outage. In larger installations like a pit puzzle parking system, backup power options or manual emergency controls are commonly provided to allow safe vehicle retrieval when needed. The exact backup solution may vary depending on the project requirements and system configuration.
